html:
Jewelry lead widget cost

Yes, CaratBase sells a lead‑generation widget for jewelers. It costs $12 per month per domain and removes the “Powered by CaratBase” attribution.

How it works for a jeweler who wants the widget on his site

  1. Visit the Widgets page and choose Widget Pro.
  2. Enter the domain where the widget will be placed.
  3. Pay the $12 /month subscription.
  4. Copy the provided code snippet and embed it on the site.
  5. Leads from visitors are sent directly to the jeweler; CaratBase does not handle the inquiry.

What you get and the cost

  • Monthly fee: $12 for each domain that hosts the widget.
  • No “Powered by CaratBase” line on the widget.
  • Direct lead delivery to the jeweler’s contact method.
  • No additional fees, no account creation required for the end‑user.

FAQ

What does the $12/month cover? It covers the widget code, removal of attribution, and routing of lead information straight to you.

Can I use the widget on multiple domains? Each domain needs its own $12 /month subscription.

Is there a free version of the widget? A basic widget is free but always displays “Powered by CaratBase.” The paid version removes that line.

Do I need to sign up for a CaratBase account? No. The widget is purchased per domain without creating a user account.

Will CaratBase sell or buy the jewelry leads? No. Leads are sent directly to the jeweler; CaratBase does not buy or sell jewelry.

Get the Widget Pro for $12/month
